# HL7 C-CDA example documents

From HL7's C-CDA-Examples repository (https://github.com/HL7/C-CDA-Examples), released under CC0 1.0:

- `transfer-summary.xml`: Documents/Transfer Summary/Transfer_Summary.xml
- `discharge-summary.xml`: Documents/Discharge Summary/Discharge_Summary.xml
- `ccd.xml`: Documents/CCD/CCD 2/CCD.xml

Unchanged. The patients and clinicians in them are invented by HL7.

One change from HL7's copy: the discharge summary's patient SSN is replaced by 111-22-3333, one of the
invalid examples internal/compliance allows, because the repository refuses anything shaped like a real SSN.
